t.p: A flexible lease is a month to month lease, which can be terminated at any time by means of a written, 1 calendar month notice to vacate.

input.name: is_no_move_out_date
input.strong: Specific Move Out Date (Last day of the selected month)

div.p: If you select a specific move-out date, we cannot guarantee availability after this date as another customer may book your unit one day after your selected move-out date.

div.strong: To finalize the booking, please make a payment.

t.p:
Thank you!
Your booking request, reference has been received. Email confirmation will be sent to the address you provided.
We will send you instructions on how to access the premises once the documentation you submitted (if you are not an existing Customer) has been approved and payment cleared into our account.
If your submitted documentation is not in order we will contact you within 20 business hours to make arrangements.
Best Regards,
The Blue Spaces Team
